# E6 — SmolVLA on Thor's measured roofline (T006)

**Generated by `bench/make_e6_reports.py` from the E6 result files**; no number is typed. Roofs are this device's measured ceilings (`results/20261022_E1_peak/hw_constants.json`: 258.2 GB/s, bf16 129.8 TFLOP/s, fp32 SIMT 6.43, TF32 62.4). DRAM bytes and FLOPs come from the counters T003 validated: DRAM bytes = (`lts__d_sectors_fill_sysmem` + `lts__t_sectors_aperture_sysmem_op_write`) × 32; tensor FLOPs = Σ `sm__ops_path_tensor_src_*`, which counts tile-padded work; SIMT FLOPs from the sass add / mul / fma counters. Kernel times come from nsys; part times from the T005 CUDA-event regions of the same configuration.
